pages.name: Shimmering Orb
pages.description: A strange shimmering orb hangs in the air before you. Rainbow highlights ripple across its surface, and an A-sharp note is clearly visible at its very center. The orb seems to be waiting for someone to sing it.

pages.name: Raccoon
pages.description: As soon as you sing A-sharp, the orb shudders and turns into a surprised raccoon. The raccoon shimmers with the same colors and listens closely. Now you clearly need to choose the next note.

pages.name: Brick
pages.description: At the higher note, the raccoon silently collapses into a red brick. The brick hangs in the air, trembling slightly in time with your voice.

pages.name: Bucket
pages.description: At the lower note, the raccoon stretches, rings, and turns into an ordinary tin bucket. The bucket hums melodiously in reply.

pages.name: Porcelain Rooster
pages.description: You sing an even higher note. The brick flashes and becomes a little porcelain rooster. The rooster crows angrily at exactly your pitch, then the orb reappears above the stage. It seems you went too high.

pages.name: Almost in Harmony
pages.description: As soon as you change direction, the object begins turning rapidly from brick to bucket to raccoon and back again. The rainbow highlights form the familiar A-sharp symbol. It seems you should now return to the original note.

pages.name: Rubber Boot
pages.description: You go even lower. The bucket flattens and becomes an enormous rubber boot. The boot hums in a deep bass, falls to the floor, and immediately vanishes. The orb reappears above the stage. It seems you went too low.

pages.name: Cheesy Harmony
pages.description: A-sharp completes the strange sequence. The rainbow object flashes with golden light, briefly becomes an enormous wheel of cheese, then scatters into musical notes. A neatly written recipe for cheese made from milk remains on the music stand.

scenePatch.description: The shimmering orb has disappeared. A golden A-sharp note remains on the music stand.

pages.name: Blizzard of Notes
pages.description: You keep changing notes without a system. The orb cannot stand it, sneezes a cloud of colorful notes, and returns to its original state. It seems random trial and error will not persuade it.

pages.name: Silence
pages.description: You decide not to experiment with unfamiliar musical magic. The orb continues shimmering peacefully above the stage.
